No support. `<-` is already an infix operator (frontdoor.rs:2007) used by `with`; special forms decode in src/compiler2/quoted_function.rs:470-486. Generators whose pattern does not match skip the element (Elixir). into: uses Collectable; reduce: threads an accumulator with `acc -> ...` clauses. Used at distill lines 24, 35, 44, 84, 103, 108, 161, 180, 248, 277.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
Fold: for is surface sugar, so it lives in src/compiler2/source_sugar.rs beside pipe, capture and lambda (rewrite_source_sugar :14), rewriting to Enum.reduce + Collectable calls with generated_variable hygiene (:450). No new Expr variant, no lowering arm, no free-name analysis change.
